fields.name: speed
fields.label: Speed (screen widths per half second)
fields.description: How far the logo moves sideways in half a second, in screen widths: 0.18 moves it 0.36 screen widths a second. It moves up and down 0.73 times as fast. 0 holds it still in the middle of the screen.

dvdBounce.name: DVD bouncing logo (JS)
dvdBounce.description: A responsive, continuously animated DVD-style logo that changes color on each bounce.
